title: The Laughing Woman
writer: Piero Schivazappa, Paolo Levi, Giuseppe Zaccariello
actors: Philippe Leroy, Dagmar Lassander, Lorenza Guerrieri
plot: A rich man with a penchant for degrading women subjects a female journalist to unpleasant S&M games, but, unbeknownst to him, she's the one who's manipulating him.
